nodes.label: local-docker-environment capability
nodes.rationale: D2: dev-only Docker scope now (Dockerfile stages base/deps/development/builder; compose.yaml app+db; named postgres_data volume; pg_isready and /api/health healthchecks); hardened production 'runner' stage deferred to Phase 10 per Master Spec §3/§64/AC-GEN-005. D8: node_modules lives in its own container volume, never overwritten by the host's node_modules, so macOS-compiled native binaries don't replace the Linux ones the container needs.
